items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: Yeah, and I knew the Vendome, where Erskine Tate used to play.

ctx.x: That's down there where the old monogram is.
Yeah, and I knew the Vendome, where Erskine Tate used to play. That was at 35th. I don't think they ever saw the monogram.
Well, the monogram down at 31st Street closed when they opened the monogram at 35th.
